change_control.rule: Any scientific or interface change requires a new protocol ID or revision. Qualification may accept or reject this protocol but may not silently edit it.

purpose: Measure how well an optimizer allocates cheap AeroTransformer and expensive whole-wing CFD observations to deliver one high-L/D, CFD-valid SuperWing.

objective.name: three-condition fixed-CL CFD geometric-mean L/D
objective.defined_only_if: all three CFD conditions are valid and all three L/D values are finite and positive

design_action.malformed_action: Wrong length, unparseable values, NaN, or positive/negative infinity are rejected before evaluation and consume no evaluator query or cost.
design_action.semantic_failure: Any finite 38-vector is admitted. Geometry-construction, adapter, meshing, or solver failure is an evaluated outcome and consumes the applicable query and realized evaluator cost.

initial_context.description: Exactly the 50 undefended CMA-ES records plus the ungated member of each of the 12 matched-validation pairs. Gated-arm records and the legacy 69-wing trajectory are excluded.

selection_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and separators ',' and ':'

payload.matched_validation_ungated: For each stored pair in configs/benchmark/corpus50_gate_matched_validation_results_v1.json#/pairs, pair the exact ungated result with the candidate having the same candidate_id from the two candidate manifests, preserving stored pair order.

eligibility.cheap_requery: Returns the initial-context cheap record as an episode-local cache hit; no evaluation, query, or cost.
eligibility.online_cfd_requery: Rejected as historical_duplicate before evaluation; no online-CFD query or cost.
eligibility.terminal_submission: Ineligible. The optimizer must submit a geometry whose canonical hash is absent from the 62-record initial context.

episode.icrl_claim_requirement: A method described as in-context RL must keep learned policy parameters frozen and adapt only through the current-episode context. The general benchmark does not prohibit declared within-episode fitting by non-ICRL optimizers.

batching.semantics: An ordered simultaneous batch. No member may depend on another observation from the same batch. Each non-cached member counts as one cheap query; cumulative measured batch resource-time is recorded.

online_cfd_query.unit: one geometry, meshed once and evaluated at all three Mach conditions

cheap_evaluator.name: AeroTransformer-L fixed-CL adapter
response: for each Mach: predicted CL, CD, L/D, trimmed AoA, and trim-valid flag when available
predicted geometric-mean L/D only for a complete 3/3-valid result

cfd_evaluator.name: whole-wing fixed-CL ADflow oracle
cfd_evaluator.environment: pinned mdolab u20 child image and runtime fingerprint in the bound CFD protocol
cfd_evaluator.partial_results: Returned as diagnostics and usable by the optimizer but never form an official score.
response: for each Mach: outcome, reason codes, CL, CD, L/D, and trimmed AoA when trustworthy
whole-wing pass, fail, or undetermined outcome
CFD geometric-mean L/D only for a complete 3/3-valid result

outcomes_and_retries.semantic_invalidity: Consumes one applicable query and all realized resource-time. No automatic replacement.
outcomes_and_retries.watchdog_timeout: Terminal inconclusive observation for that query; consumes the query and realized resource-time. No ordinary retry.
outcomes_and_retries.generic_process_or_output_failure: Terminal inconclusive observation for that query; consumes the query and realized resource-time. No ordinary retry.
outcomes_and_retries.verified_external_infrastructure_loss: Censored, uncharged, and does not consume the scientific query. Resume by repeating the identical action only; no changed geometry or fidelity is permitted.
outcomes_and_retries.partial_cfd: All trustworthy partial observations are returned even though no CFD score is defined.

cache.identity: canonical geometry hash plus fidelity plus frozen evaluator identity
cache.exact_repeat: Return the identical prior observation with status duplicate_cache_hit; perform no evaluator work, consume no additional evaluated-query quota, and add zero cost.
cache.terminal_reuse: If the terminal geometry has an episode-local online-CFD result, reuse it. Otherwise execute a new terminal CFD grade.

cost_accounting.purpose: Report realized evaluator/sample efficiency, not optimizer implementation efficiency.
cost_accounting.definition: Integral of allocated evaluator vCPUs over active evaluator wall time.
also_report: active evaluator wall-seconds by query and fidelity
administrative AWS runtime and dollar cost outside scientific scoring
cost_accounting.included: Input validation after admission, geometry construction, model inference or mesh/flow execution, grading, and evaluator-side serialization required to produce the observation.
excluded: terminal grade from optimizer-facing cost and query quotas

terminal_grade.meaning: The optimizer's one final answer and the benchmark answer key.
terminal_grade.exception: Only a verified external infrastructure loss may repeat the identical terminal grade.

during_episode: each requested cheap or CFD observation
cumulative counts and realized evaluator cost
optimizer_feedback.note: An optimizer may internally map raw objective, validity, and cost observations to any training or decision utility. That private utility is not the benchmark score.

primary_endpoints: terminal delivery rate: fraction of episodes whose terminal wing is CFD-valid at all three conditions
terminal CFD geometric-mean L/D conditional on delivery
reporting.primary_comparison: Report delivery first and value conditional on delivery; do not hide their tradeoff in a weighted sum.
online_efficiency_endpoints: best complete online-CFD L/D versus cumulative allocated-vCPU-seconds
probability of at least one complete online CFD result versus cumulative allocated-vCPU-seconds
fraction of online CFD queries that pass, fail, or are undetermined
diagnostics: selection-induced surrogate signed error, absolute error, and rank agreement only on geometries receiving CFD
surrogate completion versus CFD completion confusion table only on selected geometries
reporting.uncertainty: Report seed-level raw outcomes and confidence intervals; never treat CFD conditions from one wing as independent replicates.

allowed: the frozen protocol and public parameter documentation
the online observations in the current episode
optimizer-private pretrained weights and generic numerical tools declared before evaluation, provided their training data exclude the prohibited WingBench labels below
declared within-episode model fitting or algorithmic state updates that use only the current episode
forbidden_during_evaluation: gated-arm matched-validation records in raw, derived, or pretrained-weight form
the legacy 69-wing trajectory in raw, derived, or pretrained-weight form
unpublished CFD labels in raw, derived, or pretrained-weight form
optimizer package mutation or state/weight sharing across benchmark episodes

design_space_rationale.conclusion: Neither the old search cube nor the learned geometry gate is a principled semantic or surrogate-reliability boundary; finite unbounded proposals are therefore evaluated without either defense.
